candidate.definition_en: In a circle or curve, or so as to face in the opposite direction; around.
candidate.explanation_ar: بشكل دائري، أو في الاتجاه المعاكس (لوراء)، أو في كل مكان.

senses.definition_en: In a circle or with a circular movement, or turning to face the opposite direction.
senses.definition_ar: في حركة دائرية أو بالالتفاف في الاتجاه المعاكس.
examples: Turn round and look at what is behind you.
The wheels spun round very quickly.

senses.definition_en: To each person in a group or to different places in an area.
senses.definition_ar: لكل شخص في مجموعة أو في أماكن متفرقة داخل المكان.
examples: Pass the papers round so everyone gets a copy.
Turn round so I can see your face.
Pass the papers round to everyone in the room.
There is enough food to go round.
